svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Rails: two 1,200 mm lengths of 40 x 40 x 1.5 tube. Cross tubes: three

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 520 mm lengths, at both ends and the middle, between the rails.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Weld square on a flat table: diagonals equal within 2 mm. Tube tops

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: are 455 mm above the ground when parked. Cap the four rail ends (3 mm).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Deck: expanded steel sheet 1,200 x 520 mm laid on the cross tubes

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: between the rails, stitch welded 25 mm every 150 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Axle brackets: 60 x 5 mm plate, 247 mm long, under each rail at 630 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: from the front end, 290 mm from the centre line; 20.5 mm axle hole

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 35 mm above the bottom. Gusset 87 x 85 x 5 mm to the middle cross tube.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Hinge tabs: eight 30 x 3 mm, 75 mm long, on the rail outer faces at

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 60, 420, 780 and 1,140 mm from the front end, 39 mm above the rail top.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Handle sockets, leg clevises, shade tabs: see the frame layout picture.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: deck flat within 3 mm; axle holes line up (20 mm bar slides through).
